description: Dry-run one appointment booking. Checks the time against the seller's rules and says plainly why a time is refused, with the next open times. Checks the details and answers. On success returns approvalCard: every line that would be sent, including each answer, who gave it, and the note. Show the buyer the whole card and get their approval before using the returned handoff. Never books, holds a time, or contacts the seller. Free services only: a paid service returns the booking link for the buyer to finish themself.

accessibility.description: What the buyer said they need to take part, in their words, only when alsoAsks lists accessibility. Never infer it.

address.description: Where the appointment happens, as the buyer said it. Required when alsoAsks lists address. Never guess it.

answers.description: Answers to the seller's questions, keyed by question id from nexez_booking_options. For a choice question use one of its options exactly.

buyerAnswered.description: Ids of the questions the buyer answered themself in this conversation. A question with assistantMayAnswer false is accepted only when its id is listed here.

details.description: The buyer's own details. Never invent them.

meetingMode.description: Required when the service offers more than one way to meet.

language.description: The buyer's preferred language, only when alsoAsks lists language and the buyer said it.

link.description: Optional https web address for the seller to look at (a listing, an album, a document). Only when nexez_booking_options lists link under alsoAsks. Shown to the seller as text.

note.description: Optional plain-text note for the seller, up to 1,000 characters. It is stored as written by the assistant for the buyer, and the buyer must see it in the approval card. No Social Security, card, bank or wiring details.

start.description: Start time as an ISO instant taken from nexez_booking_options, for example 2026-11-12T16:30:00.000Z. Do not invent a time.
